import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import konumsal as ko
In [2]:
I = plt.imread("../data/domates.png")[:, :, :3]
J = ko.olceklendirme_2(I, sx=2, sy=1)
K = ko.olceklendirme_2(I, sx=1, sy=2)

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
plt.subplot(1, 3, 1)
plt.imshow(I)

plt.subplot(1, 3, 2)
plt.imshow(J)

plt.subplot(1, 3, 3)
plt.imshow(K)
plt.show()
